According to arXiv 2411.13808, two ways the EU AI Act and the Frontier AI Safety Commitments support multi-stakeholder GPAI evaluation portability are:

1. The EU AI Act outlines that at least three distinct parties may run GPAI evaluations: GPAI providers, the EU AI Office, and qualified independent experts on behalf of the AI Office. This framework facilitates the involvement of multiple stakeholders in the evaluation process.

2. The Frontier AI Safety Commitments encourage signatories to consider results from internal and external evaluations, including those conducted by independent third-party evaluators, thereby promoting collaboration and external scrutiny among various stakeholders.
